name: Urbanimmersive Inc.
summary: Urbanimmersive Inc. provides SaaS business management solutions to 3D visual content providers in Canada. The company operates in two segments, Software and Photography Equipment. The Software segment provides SaaS marketing platform to professional photographers and other immersive visual content providers. The Photography Equipment segment resells 3D photography equipment. The company's platform enables customers to enhance operational productivity and delivers visual content creations through websites builder tool, AI-backed image indexing, robust file transfer systems, and interactive visual technology solutions. It also offers 3D emulator technology, a visual content recognition post-production algorithm that delivers online and offline alternatives to traditional 3D engines for the creation of immersive digital environments. In addition, the company provides immersive 3D tours, floor plans and measurements, 3D pocket websites, single property websites, real estate video, image delivery, HDR image processing, and photographer business solutions. It serves residential, commercial, and construction real estate markets and local businesses. The company was formerly known as Urbanimmersive Technologies Inc. and changed its name to Urbanimmersive Inc. in October 2015. Urbanimmersive Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Laval, Canada.
